attempts.rationale: The unstable ranking and correlated errors suggest a robust weighting; try softmax_neg_error over the full pool.
Test a robust weighting that uses error magnitude directly – inverse_error – to see if a simpler weight improves on softmax_neg_error given the unstable ranking.
testing a robust but simpler central tendency (median) to see if it improves over weighted.

testing a simple robust mean over the full pool to see if central tendency beats weighted.
test a per‑horizon top‑k mean weighting (handles w4) to exploit horizon‑specific model strengths in this strongly seasonal series.
The series has unstable ranking and strong seasonality; a per‑horizon best‑model weighting could capture horizon‑specific strengths.
Try a robust softmax‑neg‑error weighting on the reduced pool4 to see if a less extreme weighting improves over the inverse‑error result (ranking unstable, high correlation groups).
Try a simple robust mean over the more stable subset pool4 (trend/seasonality strong, unstable ranking).
Test a robust dba combination on the stable pool4 to see if it improves over weighted approaches, given the unstable ranking and strong seasonality.
Test a robust weighted combination on the smaller, more stable pool4 using inverse_error weights to see if a simpler weight improves over softmax on full pool.

decision.justification: Selected 'dba' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9954. Series context: trend strength 1.0 and seasonal strength 1.0; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.092); 5 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.949.
